message: The Atelier will be closed from July 24 to September 15
title: Summer closure
subtitle: Thank you for your patience and trust
contentDescription:
The Atelier will be closed for the summer holidays from July 24 to September 15 inclusive.

Activity will resume normally from **September 16**. Thank you for your understanding and patience.

In the meantime, happy flying to all!
